title: Jubilant Briny Dutch Macaroni Pasta
description: A Dutch-inspired brunch dish featuring macaroni, served in a stone bowl and wrapped in a ti leaf, with a focus on briny flavors and aerated texture, making it sugar-free-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the macaroni according to package instructions until al dente, then set aside.
In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat and saute the chopped pickled herring until lightly browned.
Add the cooked macaroni to the skillet, stirring to combine with the herring and butter mixture.
Season with sea salt to taste, then stir in the chopped parsley and grated gouda cheese until the cheese is melted and well combined.
Spoon the macaroni mixture into the stone bowl dolsot, then wrap each bowl in a ti leaf.
Bake the wrapped bowls in the preheated oven for 10 minutes, or until the ti leaves are lightly browned and the macaroni is heated through.
Remove the bowls from the oven and serve immediately.
